title: ‘1619,’ Episode 5: The Land of Our Fathers, Part 1

sentences.en: Yeah, just be careful because it will kind of slice you.
sentences.zh: 对，小心点，这东西会割人的。

sentences.en: That's not a better sound to hear that sugar cane move.
sentences.zh: 听着甘蔗移动的声音，感觉不太妙。

sentences.en: It's very thick.
sentences.zh: 长得很密实。

sentences.en: You know, to turn over that dirt and to watch this thing from a few inches to grow into almost a 12-foot stalk is just amazing.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，翻开那些泥土，看着这东西从几英寸长到差不多12英尺高的茎，简直太神奇了。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't realize how depressed I get, you know, when I see people getting ready to plant cane because that was my time of the year.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我没意识到自己会变得这么沮丧，你知道的，当我看到人们准备种植甘蔗时，因为那是我的季节。

sentences.en: That was like, I would wake up just so pumped, ready to go to the shop and start repairing wagons.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就像，我醒来时会充满活力，准备去车间开始修理马车。

sentences.en: That was my, you know, just, that was mine.
sentences.zh: 那是我的，你知道的，那完全属于我。

sentences.en: And I miss it.
sentences.zh: 我怀念它。

sentences.en: I miss it so much.
sentences.zh: 我太想念它了。

sentences.en: I can't say enough how I miss this.
sentences.zh: 我无法用言语表达我有多想念这一切。

sentences.en: Do you think the fields miss you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得土地会想念你吗？

sentences.en: Oh, I know they miss me because I used to talk to them all the time.
sentences.zh: 哦，我知道它们想念我，因为我过去常常跟它们说话。

sentences.en: What would you say?
sentences.zh: 你会说些什么？

sentences.en: I mean, I want y'all to do well.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我希望你们都能长得好。

sentences.en: I want y'all to grow well.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们都能茁壮成长。

sentences.en: Sounds silly to an unheard person.
sentences.zh: 对没听过的人来说，这听起来很傻。

sentences.en: Like, why are you talking to dirt?
sentences.zh: 比如，你为什么跟泥土说话？

sentences.en: But it's just like, the love that you have for the land is just, I mean, it's unreal.
sentences.zh: 但这就好像，你对这片土地的爱，我是说，太真实了，无法用言语形容。

sentences.en: It's unreal.
sentences.zh: 太真实了。

sentences.en: What would you say to it now?
sentences.zh: 你现在会对它说些什么？

sentences.en: That I want it back.
sentences.zh: 说我想要回它。

sentences.en: I want the land back.
sentences.zh: 我想要回这片土地。

sentences.en: From the New York Times Magazine, I'm Nicole Hannah-Jones.
sentences.zh: 这里是《纽约时报杂志》，我是妮可·汉娜-琼斯。

sentences.en: This is 1619.
In the fall of 1864, at the height of the Civil War, one of the most famous Union generals, William Tecumseh Sherman, begins his march out of the city of Atlanta to the sea.
sentences.zh: 在1864年秋天，南北战争正酣之际，联邦军最著名的将军之一威廉·特库姆塞·谢尔曼，开始了他从亚特兰大城向大海进发的进军。

sentences.en: And as Sherman and his men make their way through Georgia, Black Southerners are seeing an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 正当谢尔曼和他的部下穿过佐治亚州时，南方的黑人看到了一个机会。

sentences.en: And so by the thousands, they start to leave the plantations where they've been enslaved and are falling behind Sherman's troops as they make their way to the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 于是成千上万的人开始离开他们曾被奴役的种植园，在谢尔曼的部队前往海岸的途中紧随其后。

sentences.en: But these newly liberated people were not exactly welcomed.
sentences.zh: 但这些刚刚获得自由的人并没有受到真正的欢迎。

sentences.en: Sherman didn't actually oppose slavery.
sentences.zh: 谢尔曼实际上并不反对奴隶制。

sentences.en: And so he's really not that sympathetic to those who are fleeing these plantations.
sentences.zh: 因此，他对那些逃离种植园的人其实并没有太多同情。

sentences.en: And he also sees them as a drain on his resources.
sentences.zh: 而且他也认为这些人会消耗他的资源。

sentences.en: There are families.
sentences.zh: 这里有许多家庭。

sentences.en: There are people of all ages, young and old, who need food and care.
sentences.zh: 有各个年龄段的人，无论老少，都需要食物和照顾。

sentences.en: And they are slowing the troops down.
sentences.zh: 他们拖慢了军队的行进速度。

sentences.en: By December of that year, some of Sherman's troops are about to approach Savannah.
sentences.zh: 到了那一年的12月，谢尔曼的一些部队即将接近萨凡纳。

sentences.en: And they come up on a creek that is both too wide and too deep to cross without a bridge.
sentences.zh: 他们遇到了一条小溪，又宽又深，没有桥根本无法过河。

sentences.en: So the troops start building one.
sentences.zh: 于是军队开始造桥。

sentences.en: And they instruct the Black people who are following them to just wait, that the troops need to cross first, but then they'll be able to come after.
sentences.zh: 他们指示跟随他们的黑人原地等待，说军队需要先过河，然后他们才能跟过来。

sentences.en: But the Confederate Army is on their heels.
sentences.zh: 但邦联军队就在他们身后紧追不舍。

sentences.en: And once the Union troops cross, they break up the bridge,
sentences.zh: 一旦联邦军队过河，他们就拆毁了桥梁，

sentences.en: leaving all those people who had just escaped slavery behind to face either the icy waters or the rebel army that was in pursuit.
sentences.zh: 把那些刚逃离奴隶制的人全部抛在身后，让他们去面对冰冷的河水或是穷追不舍的叛军。

sentences.en: It is a massacre.
sentences.zh: 这是一场大屠杀。

sentences.en: Some of them drown trying to swim across.
sentences.zh: 有些人试图游过去却淹死了。

sentences.en: Others are trampled or shot to death.
sentences.zh: 其他人则被踩踏或枪杀致死。

sentences.en: And those who remain are captured and re-enslaved.
sentences.zh: 剩下的人则被俘虏并重新沦为奴隶。

sentences.en: When word gets back to Lincoln's Secretary of War, Edwin Stanton, he is outraged.
sentences.zh: 当消息传到林肯的战争部长埃德温·斯坦顿耳中时，他愤怒不已。

sentences.en: He has Sherman pull together a meeting with 20 Black church leaders.
sentences.zh: 他让谢尔曼召集了一场会议，与20位黑人教会领袖会面。

sentences.en: There's a transcript of this meeting, and it shows that these two men, Stanton and Sherman, actually turn to this group of Black leaders and ask them,
sentences.zh: 这场会议有文字记录，它显示这两个人，斯坦顿和谢尔曼，确实转向这群黑人领袖并问他们：

sentences.en: What do you want for your own people, what do you want for your own people?
sentences.zh: 你们为自己的同胞想要什么，你们为自己的同胞想要什么？

sentences.en: Speaking for the group, one of the men tells them, the way we can best take care of ourselves is to have land and turn it and till it by our own labor.
sentences.zh: 代表发言的一名男子告诉他们，我们能照顾好自己的最佳方式，就是拥有土地，并通过我们自己的劳动去翻耕它。

sentences.en: That is, by the labor of the women and children and old men, and we can soon maintain ourselves and have something to spare.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，通过妇女、儿童和老人的劳动，我们就能很快养活自己并有所富余。

sentences.en: And what's remarkable is that Sherman turns that request of those men for land to work for themselves into a government order, Special Order No.
sentences.zh: 引人注目的是，谢尔曼将这些人要求土地来为自己劳作的请求，变成了一项政府命令——第15号特别命令。
第15号。

sentences.en: It's said that the government would take 400,000 acres that it had seized from the Confederacy and split it up among those thousands of newly emancipated people.
sentences.zh: 据说政府将从邦联没收40万英亩土地，将其分给成千上万新近获得解放的人。

sentences.en: This becomes what is perhaps the most famous provision of the Reconstruction period, which we all know as 40 acres and a mule.
sentences.zh: 这就成为了重建时期最著名的规定，也就是我们都知道的“四十英亩和一头骡子”。

sentences.en: President Lincoln approves the order, but soon after, he's assassinated.
sentences.zh: 林肯总统批准了这项命令，但不久之后他就被暗杀了。

sentences.en: And Andrew Johnson, a Southerner who had once enslaved people himself, takes over the presidency and quickly overturns it.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·约翰逊——一个曾经自己也蓄奴的南方人——接任了总统职务，并很快推翻了该命令。

sentences.en: And within a few short months, the small amount of land that had been distributed to Black people was returned to white Southerners.
sentences.zh: 在短短几个月内，分发给黑人的那一小块土地又被归还给了南方白人。

sentences.en: Do you want me to pull around?
sentences.zh: 你要我把车开过去吗？

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a good idea.
sentences.zh: 好，这是个好主意。

sentences.en: Adiza Egan, tell me about your trip to Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 阿迪扎·埃根，跟我讲讲你对路易斯安那州的旅行吧。

sentences.en: So I went to Louisiana because, despite the fact that 40 acres and a mule was reversed and that land was taken,
sentences.zh: 我之所以去路易斯安那州，是因为尽管“四十英亩和一头骡子”的政策被推翻，土地也被收回，

sentences.en: Black people actually managed to acquire a significant amount of land.
sentences.zh: 但黑人实际上还是设法获得了一定数量的土地。

sentences.en: Okay, now let's navigate.
sentences.zh: 好，现在我们来导个航。

sentences.en: By the 1920s, Black people owned about a million farms, which is actually 14% of all the farms in the country at that time, which reflected the population of Black people.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪20年代，黑人拥有大约一百万个农场，这实际上占当时全国所有农场的14%，这与黑人的人口比例相符。

sentences.en: But in the decades that followed, that number has dropped drastically, from 14% to below 2%.
sentences.zh: 但在随后的几十年里，这个数字急剧下降，从14%降至2%以下。

sentences.en: And so to understand why that's happened, I went down there.
sentences.zh: 为了弄清楚为什么会发生这种情况，我去了那里。

sentences.en: So we're going to get our radio going.
sentences.zh: 我们要打开收音机。

sentences.en: With another producer, Annie Brown.
sentences.zh: 和另一位制作人安妮·布朗一起。

sentences.en: Iberia's only daily live call-in talk show.
sentences.zh: 伊比利亚唯一的每日现场连线脱口秀节目。

sentences.en: To a city just a couple hours outside of New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 去一个距离新奥尔良只有几个小时车程的城市。

sentences.en: Mandy gives them, be fruitful and multiply.
sentences.zh: 曼迪送给他们的话是：生养众多，遍满地面。

sentences.en: Where the streets are named after plantations.
sentences.zh: 那里的街道都是以种植园的名字命名的。

sentences.en: It's harvest time, glory be to God.
sentences.zh: 丰收的季节到了，感谢上帝。

sentences.en: And the crops that grew during slavery still drive the local economy.
sentences.zh: 奴隶制时期种植的农作物至今仍驱动着当地的经济。

sentences.en: And where many people can trace their family line back to the enslavers.
sentences.zh: 许多人的家谱可以追溯到奴隶主。

sentences.en: Or the enslaved.
sentences.zh: 或是被奴役者。

sentences.en: Like Angie and Wenceslas Provost Jr.
sentences.zh: 比如安吉和小温塞斯拉·普罗沃斯特。

sentences.en: My name is Wenceslas Provost Jr.
sentences.zh: 我叫小温塞斯拉·普罗沃斯特。

sentences.en: I go by the name of June ProvoSt.
sentences.zh: 大家都叫我琼·普罗沃斯特。

sentences.en: Have you ever met a Wenceslas before?
sentences.zh: 你以前见过叫温塞斯拉的人吗？

sentences.en: How's it spelled?
sentences.zh: 这名字怎么拼？

sentences.en: W-E-N-C-E-S-L-A-U-S.
sentences.zh: W-E-N-C-E-S-L-A-U-S.

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 见过的。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: First day of school was always rough with Wenceslas.
sentences.zh: 开学第一天叫温塞斯拉总是很艰难。

sentences.en: What would happen?
sentences.zh: 会发生什么？

sentences.en: Oh, Winclaus, Wincosalus, Winchester.
sentences.zh: 哦，温克劳斯、温科萨卢斯、温切斯特。

sentences.en: You name it, I've been called it, yes.
sentences.zh: 你能想到的名字，我都被人叫过，是的。

sentences.en: And then high school, they just started calling me June ProvoSt.
sentences.zh: 后来到了高中，他们开始叫我琼·普罗沃斯特。

sentences.en: Because I was a junior, so I was okay with that.
sentences.zh: 因为我是小辈（Junior），所以我对此挺能接受的。

sentences.en: June Bug, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: June Bug, a.k.a.

sentences.en: my man.
sentences.zh: 我的好兄弟。

sentences.en: So June and Angie descend from a long line of sugarcane farmers, going back prior to emancipation.
sentences.zh: 所以琼和安吉是长期从事甘蔗种植的世家后代，可以追溯到解放前。

sentences.en: Charles de Vanzo Olivier, your great-great-great-grandpa?
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·德·万佐·奥利维尔，你的高祖父？
zh_words: 查尔斯·德·万佐·奥利维尔

sentences.en: Okay, all right.
sentences.zh: 好，没问题。

sentences.en: Okay, I might have to tell this story.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我可能得讲讲这个故事。

sentences.en: And each generation in June's case was able to pass down the livelihood.
sentences.zh: 在琼的家族中，每一代人都将这份谋生手艺传承了下来。

sentences.en: June's family is so important historically to the area.
sentences.zh: 琼的家族对这个地区有着极其重要的历史意义。

sentences.en: So his great-great-grandfather taught his great-grandfather.
sentences.zh: 他的高祖父教了他的曾祖父。

sentences.en: And his great-grandfather taught his grandfather.
sentences.zh: 他的曾祖父教了他的祖父。

sentences.en: June's family was one of the larger farMs.
sentences.zh: 琼的家族曾拥有较大的农场之一。

sentences.en: And his grandfather taught his dad.
sentences.zh: 他的祖父教了他的父亲。

sentences.en: As long as I can remember my dad, he would always call me his right-hand man.
sentences.zh: 从我有记忆起，我爸总是叫我他的得力助手。

sentences.en: That was his little saying for me.
sentences.zh: 那是他经常对我说的话。

sentences.en: He would take me riding with him, like, all the time.
sentences.zh: 他总是带我一起兜风，基本上随时都带着我。

sentences.en: So for June, that training started early.
sentences.zh: 所以对琼来说，这种训练很早就开始了。

sentences.en: He was driving his first tractor when he was seven.
sentences.zh: 他七岁时就在开第一台拖拉机了。

sentences.en: Like, what did it feel like for you to be driving the truck?
sentences.zh: 比如，你当时开卡车是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Oh, I was, like, smiling ear-to-ear.
sentences.zh: 哦，我当时笑得合不拢嘴。

sentences.en: I thought I was on top of the world.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己就像站在世界之巅。

sentences.en: I mean, I was, like, I'm driving tractor at seven years old.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我当时觉得，我七岁就在开拖拉机了。

sentences.en: That was a toy for me.
sentences.zh: 那对我说就是个玩具。

sentences.en: That was amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And my thing was just to be next to my dad.
sentences.zh: 我唯一的想法就是待在我爸身边。

sentences.en: That was my whole thing, to be next to my dad.
sentences.zh: 我满脑子想的就是待在我爸身边。

sentences.en: I mean, just those little moments, like, okay, for instance, now we have tractors that drive themselves.
sentences.zh: 我是说，就那些小瞬间，比如，举个例子，现在我们有了会自己开的拖拉机。

sentences.en: But at the time, when you want to draw a straight row, we had to, like, pick a tree or something very far to make a straight arrow.
sentences.zh: 但在当时，如果你想画出一条笔直的垄沟，我们必须挑选一棵树或非常远的东西作为参照来画出一条直线。

sentences.en: And I'll never forget looking at my dad, pointing a tree out.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记看着我爸指向一棵树。

sentences.en: And this might have been, like, three-quarters of a mile, possibly.
sentences.zh: 这可能大概有四分之三英里远吧。

sentences.en: Like, pointing one tree out and making a straight row.
sentences.zh: 比如指向一棵树然后开出一条直线。

sentences.en: And I remember we had landowners who were coming in and saying, how y'all do that so straight?
sentences.zh: 我记得有地主过来问，你们怎么能把垄沟犁得这么直？

sentences.en: And my dad was the one to do that.
sentences.zh: 而我爸就是那个能做到的人。

sentences.en: And it was, like, my dad is a bad man.
sentences.zh: 当时觉得，我爸太牛了。

sentences.en: Like, really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Like, I mean, like, I want to do that one day.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我也想有一天能做到那样。

sentences.en: June saw the connection his dad had to the land.
sentences.zh: 琼看到了他父亲与土地之间的联系。

sentences.en: But like a lot of sugarcane farmers, most of the land his dad farmed was rented from white landowners.
sentences.zh: 但就像许多甘蔗种植者一样，他父亲耕种的大部分土地都是从白人地主那里租来的。

sentences.en: And so, when June's dad was finally able to buy a tract of land...
sentences.zh: 所以，当琼的父亲终于买下一片土地时……

sentences.en: It was a 60-acre tract.
sentences.zh: 那是一块60英亩的土地。

sentences.en: June understood what his father was actually working for.
sentences.zh: 琼明白了父亲究竟在为之努力什么。

sentences.en: That was, you know, one of the first big pieces of land that he bought.
sentences.zh: 那是他买下的第一批大块土地之一。

sentences.en: And I remember we chopped the land up.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们清理那片土地。

sentences.en: We cleaned trees.
sentences.zh: 我们清理树木。

sentences.en: I mean, the land was looking great.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那片土地看起来棒极了。

sentences.en: And when we started drawing the rows up, you know, we was talking and it just, like, all of a sudden it just, something just came over him.
sentences.zh: 当我们开始画垄沟时，你知道的，我们还在聊天，突然之间，某种情绪涌上心头。

sentences.en: He just, like, dropped to his knees.
sentences.zh: 他突然就跪倒在地。

sentences.en: And he just kind of grabbed that dirt and he said, you know what, this is my land.
sentences.zh: 他抓起一把泥土说，你知道吗，这是我的土地。

sentences.en: And nobody can take this.
sentences.zh: 谁也夺不走。

sentences.en: When June graduates from high school, his dad gives him 21 acres, basically so he can start his own farm.
sentences.zh: 琼高中毕业时，他父亲给了他21英亩土地，基本上是为了让他开始自己的农场经营。

sentences.en: And so June's thinking, he's going to be out there with his dad all summer.
sentences.zh: 所以琼本以为整个夏天都能跟父亲一起在地里干活。

sentences.en: But then his dad gets sick.
sentences.zh: 但接着他父亲生病了。

sentences.en: He has to go in for heart surgery.
sentences.zh: 他不得不去动心脏手术。

sentences.en: So at 18 years old, June is left responsible with one of the most important jobs on the farm.
sentences.zh: 于是18岁的琼不得不挑起重担，负责农场里最核心的工作之一。

sentences.en: Planting cane.
sentences.zh: 种植甘蔗。

sentences.en: Was that your first time ever being responsible for planting?
sentences.zh: 那是你第一次独自负责种植吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I remember all my workers would ridicule me because I would, like, be on my hands and knees making sure, you know, I didn't put too much dirt when you're covering.
sentences.zh: 我记得所有的工人都嘲笑我，因为我当时跪在地上，确保自己在覆土时没有盖上太多的泥土。

sentences.en: June is so neurotic about doing a good job that he's on his hands and knees making sure that the cane is covered with just the right amount of dirt.
sentences.zh: 琼对把工作做好有着近乎强迫般的执着，他跪在地上，确保甘蔗上覆盖着恰到好处的泥土。

sentences.en: That following year, I remember telling my dad, I said, you know what, the cane I planted came out better than the ones y'all planted when it was all together.
sentences.zh: 第二年，我记得我跟我爸说，你知道吗，我种出来的甘蔗比你们一起种出来的还要好。

sentences.en: Because we caught a great stand.
sentences.zh: 因为我们赶上了极好的出苗率。

sentences.en: I mean, it was just beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那真的很美。

sentences.en: Is that the year that you guys all won in 94?
sentences.zh: 那是你们大家都在94年获胜的那一年吗？

sentences.en: I think it was in 1994, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我想那是在1994年，是的。

sentences.en: So every year, the state has this contest, and they award the farmer who produces the most sugar per acre.
sentences.zh: 所以每年，州里都有这样一个比赛，他们会奖励每英亩产糖量最高的农场主。

sentences.en: In that year there, I was actually first in the non-quota.
sentences.zh: 在那一年里，我其实在非配额组里拿了第一。

sentences.en: Non-quota is when you had, like, 100 acres or less.
sentences.zh: 非配额组是指你拥有100英亩或更少土地的时候。

sentences.en: So I was actually number one in the state.
sentences.zh: 所以我其实是全州第一名。

sentences.en: And my dad was 13th in the state, if I want to say.
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，我爸爸是全州第13名。

sentences.en: So that was a great year for us.
sentences.zh: 所以对我们来说那真是棒极的一年。

sentences.en: You're beating your dad.
sentences.zh: 你把把你爸比下去了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was beating my dad.
sentences.zh: 对，我把我爸比下去了。

sentences.en: Exactly, yes.
sentences.zh: 没错，是的。

sentences.en: And actually, we talked about that for a long time.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们这件事谈论了好久。

sentences.en: Yes, I ragged him, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，我拿这事取笑过他，是的。

sentences.en: And what also happened is they caught the attention of everybody in the area.
sentences.zh: 同时发生的是，他们引起了当地所有人的注意。

sentences.en: Word of mouth started going around, and, like, landowner after landowner was coming to us, wanting us to farm their property.
sentences.zh: 口碑开始传开，地主一个接一个地找到我们，想让我们去种他们的地。

sentences.en: And that's how we just started expanding even more.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们开始进一步扩张的原因。

sentences.en: And this is how it is for the next decade or so.
sentences.zh: 接下来的十年左右差不多都是这样。

sentences.en: Business is good.
sentences.zh: 生意很好。

sentences.en: June and his dad are taking on more land leases, farming more property.
sentences.zh: 琼和他的父亲接下了更多的土地租赁，耕种更多的产业。

sentences.en: And in the middle of all this is when he meets Angie.
sentences.zh: 正是在这一切当中，他遇到了安吉。

sentences.zh: 尽管她的家人在德克萨斯州住了很多年，但她的祖辈是来自路易斯安那州的甘蔗农。

sentences.en: So when she met June...
sentences.zh: 所以当她遇到琼时……

sentences.en: It was as if I'd known him for centuries.
sentences.zh: 就好像我已经认识他好几个世纪了一样。

sentences.en: Like, our past lives were together or something.
sentences.zh: 就像我们的前世就在一起过或者别的什么。

sentences.en: It's so really deep.

sentences.en: I was only familiar with Keith Sweat as, like, part of the R&B canon of baby making music.
sentences.zh: 我只知道基思·斯威特是那种作为制造浪漫情调的R&B音乐代表人物之一。

sentences.zh: 对，就在那时我转过身开始跟着唱。

sentences.zh: 唱吧！

sentences.zh: 你们最好别放这个。

sentences.en: And so when they get married, they have a farm-themed wedding.
sentences.zh: 所以当他们结婚时，他们办了一场农场主题的婚礼。

sentences.en: They put sugarcane leaves on the walls, like, as decoration, almost like wreaths.
sentences.zh: 他们在墙上挂了甘蔗叶作为装饰，几乎就像花环一样。

sentences.en: And then after the reception, they rode off in a tractor.
sentences.zh: 然后接待结束后，他们开着拖拉机离开了。

sentences.en: It's so cutely country.
sentences.zh: 真是土得可爱。

sentences.en: It's very cute.
sentences.zh: 非常可爱。

sentences.en: So sugarcane is really their lives?
sentences.zh: 所以甘蔗真的是他们的全部生活？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Sugarcane is 100% their lives.
sentences.zh: 甘蔗百分之百就是他们的生活。

sentences.en: That's where the problem really starts.
sentences.zh: 问题也就是从这里开始的。

sentences.zh: 据《60分钟》报道，《杀死一只知更鸟》是百老汇历史上最成功的美国话剧。

sentences.zh: 这本书，名叫《美国的黑人农场主》，琼的家人在书中被报道了。

sentences.en: So that's where this picture comes from.
sentences.zh: 所以这张照片就是这么来的。

sentences.en: So who all is in the photo?
sentences.zh: 那照片里都有谁？

sentences.en: June's brother, Rodney.
sentences.zh: 琼的哥哥罗德尼。

sentences.en: June's father.
sentences.zh: 琼的父亲。

sentences.en: June's brother, Edward.
sentences.zh: 琼的哥哥爱德华。

sentences.en: And June.
sentences.zh: 还有琼。

sentences.en: June's family was so motivating to see because they were one of the, you know, beacons of hope out there, of light, farmers that would remain in business.
sentences.zh: 看到琼的家人真是备受鼓舞，因为他们是那种你知道的、行业里的希望灯塔、微光，是坚持继续营业的农场主。

sentences.en: And that is not the story.
sentences.zh: 但故事并非如此。

sentences.en: Right around the time when June meets Angie, things start to change.
sentences.zh: 就在琼遇到安吉前后，事情开始发生变化。

sentences.en: June's dad's health has continued to deteriorate.
sentences.zh: 琼父亲的健康状况持续恶化。

sentences.en: At that time, he was actually almost incapable of working on a farm on a day-to-day basis.
sentences.zh: 当时，他其实已经几乎无法从事日常的农场工作了。

sentences.en: So June took over the farm.
sentences.zh: 所以琼接管了农场。

sentences.en: So my production went from a 300-acre operation to close to a 5,000-acre farm.
sentences.zh: 所以我的生产规模从一个300英亩的农场扩大到了将近5000英亩。

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: And at the beginning of the year in 2008...
sentences.zh: 在2008年年初……

sentences.en: I went in 2008 to get a crop loan.
sentences.zh: 我在2008年去申请了一笔农作物贷款。

sentences.en: June does what he'd seen his father do every year.
sentences.zh: 琼做了他看父亲每年都在做的事。

sentences.en: He goes to the bank and gets a crop loan.
sentences.zh: 他去银行申请了一笔农作物贷款。

sentences.en: You need a loan every year to farm sugar cane.
sentences.zh: 种甘蔗每年都需要贷款。

sentences.en: So why would a successful farmer with a lot of land need to take out a crop loan every year?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么一个拥有大量土地的成功农场主每年都需要申请农作物贷款呢？

sentences.en: So this is just how farming works.
sentences.zh: 这就是农业的运作方式。

sentences.en: Farmers make their money at the end of the season.
sentences.zh: 农场主在赛季结束时赚钱。

sentences.en: And so in order to cover costs like fertilizer, equipment, labor, they take out a loan.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了支付化肥、设备、人工等成本，他们会申请贷款。

sentences.en: And so to run a sugar cane farm the size of June's, it costs around $2 million.
sentences.zh: 所以要经营一个像琼这样规模的甘蔗农场，大约需要200万美元。

sentences.en: And then when you sell your cane to the sugar mill, that's how you pay back that amount of money.
sentences.zh: 然后当你把甘蔗卖给糖厂时，你就是用这笔钱来还贷。

sentences.en: But June can't go to the bank that his dad went to because that bank has stopped giving out crop loans.
sentences.zh: 但琼不能去他父亲去过的那家银行，因为那家银行已经停止发放农作物贷款了。

sentences.en: So he has to find another bank.
sentences.zh: 所以他必须找到另一家银行。

sentences.en: He ends up applying for a crop loan at a place called First Guarantee Bank.
sentences.zh: 他最后在一家名为第一担保银行的地方申请农作物贷款。

sentences.en: This is First Guarantee Bank.
sentences.zh: 这里是第一担保银行。

sentences.en: How can I help you?
sentences.zh: 有什么我可以帮您的吗？

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Adiza Egan.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫阿迪扎·伊甘。

sentences.en: I'm from the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: I'm recording this call, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，我在录音。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I'm doing good.
sentences.zh: 我挺好的。

sentences.en: How about you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: I'm actually looking to speak to someone about a lawsuit that the bank is involved in.
sentences.zh: 我其实是想找人了解一下银行卷入的一起诉讼。

sentences.en: We're trying to get a response to something.
sentences.zh: 我们正试图就某些事情得到一个回应。

sentences.en: And what happens between June and the bank is now the subject of a lawsuit currently making its way through the legal system.
sentences.zh: 琼和银行之间发生的事情现在成了一起诉讼的主题，目前正在法律系统中审理。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Let me get you my branch manager.
sentences.zh: 我帮你找我们的分行经理。

sentences.en: We've reached out to the bank multiple times, but they haven't responded to us.
sentences.zh: 我们多次联系过银行，但他们没有回应我们。

sentences.en: They've also publicly denied all of June's allegations.
sentences.zh: 他们还公开否认了琼的所有指控。

sentences.en: But this is what June says happened.
sentences.zh: 但这是琼所说的事情经过。

sentences.en: I went to First Guarantee Bank to apply for a crop loan.
sentences.zh: 我去了第一担保银行申请农作物贷款。

sentences.en: He says he goes to the bank and he shows them how many acres he's planning to farm.
sentences.zh: 他说他去了银行，向他们展示了他计划耕种多少英亩土地。

sentences.en: He also shows them his financial history, his taxes, his credit.
sentences.zh: 他还向他们展示了他的财务历史、纳税记录和信用状况。

sentences.en: And June is expecting to receive something that's similar to what his dad had received all those years before.
sentences.zh: 琼期望得到类似于他父亲多年前得到的贷款。

sentences.en: But after he applies, he doesn't hear anything back.
sentences.zh: 但在他申请之后，他没有得到任何回音。

sentences.en: And time is passing.
sentences.zh: 时间一天天过去。

sentences.en: I mean, every day that passed is crucial to the operation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，过去的每一天对农场运作都至关重要。

sentences.en: So he starts to get a little nervous.
sentences.zh: 所以他开始有点紧张了。

sentences.en: All my landlords are starting to call and ask for a land ring.
sentences.zh: 我所有的地主都开始打电话索要土地租金了。

sentences.en: Okay, now people are starting to spray herbicides.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在人们开始喷洒除草剂了。

sentences.en: So people's crops are getting clean.
sentences.zh: 所以大家的庄稼都在变干净。

sentences.en: Here I am, you know, not even touching the fields.
sentences.zh: 而我呢，你知道的，甚至连田地都还没碰过。

sentences.en: And you go ride and you see all your neighbors.
sentences.zh: 你去转转就会看到你所有的邻居。

sentences.en: All these white farmers are in the fields, have all their tractors running.
sentences.zh: 所有这些白人农场主都在地里，所有的拖拉机都在运转。

sentences.en: And I have everything parked at the shop.
sentences.zh: 而我的所有东西都停在车间里。

sentences.en: A similar thing had happened to his cousin a couple years before.
sentences.zh: 几年前他的表哥也发生过类似的事情。

sentences.en: I seen my cousin, we call him Papoose, that's his nickname, was fertilizing in the end of June.
sentences.zh: 我看到我表哥，我们叫他帕普斯，那是他的外号，在6月底还在施肥。

sentences.en: Like, my dad always wanted to fertilize early.
sentences.zh: 就像我爸爸总是希望早点施肥。

sentences.en: Like, I mean, the earliest we could have fertilized, the better, because you can't get a good jump start.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们能越早施肥越好，因为这样你才能抢占先机。

sentences.en: And to pass and see him fertilizing at the end of June was like, like, what was going on?
sentences.zh: 结果路过看到他在6月底施肥，就像是，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Like, what was happening?
sentences.zh: 就像是，发生什么事了？

sentences.en: And June had started to hear rumors.
sentences.zh: 而琼开始听到一些传言。

sentences.en: The word was always, you know, oh, that Olivier guy, he's not going to be farming long.
sentences.zh: 大家的说法一直是，哦，那个叫奥利维耶的家伙，他可种不了多久地。

sentences.en: You don't like to get up early in the morning and he...
sentences.zh: 你早上不喜欢早起而且他……

sentences.en: Were they implying that he didn't know what he was doing?
sentences.zh: 他们是在暗示他根本不知道自己在做什么吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: They were implying his farming practices were bad.
sentences.zh: 他们是在暗示他的耕作方法很糟糕。

sentences.en: He was lazy.
sentences.zh: 他很懒。

sentences.en: I mean, all of the above.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，以上种种都有。

sentences.en: And now he was worried people would start saying the same things about him.
sentences.zh: 现在他担心人们也会开始对他说同样的话。

sentences.en: Finally, at the beginning of March, the bank does approve his crop loan.
sentences.zh: 终于，在3月初，银行批准了他的农作物贷款。

sentences.en: But the problem was, the crop loan was very underfunded.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，这笔农作物贷款资金严重不足。

sentences.en: But it's for less than half of what he expected.
sentences.zh: 但这笔钱甚至不到他预期的一半。

sentences.en: Did they say why?
sentences.zh: 他们说为什么了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I mean, he just said, this is what I'm giving you.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他当时就说，这就是我给你的支持。

sentences.en: So, you know, you take the loan and you try to farm the best way you can with that loan.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，你只能贷这笔款，然后尽你最大努力去种地。

sentences.en: But it's just, by time, you know, I pay land rent, spray chemicals, fertilizer, I'm out of funds already.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，随着时间推移，付了地租、买了农药和化肥后，我资金就已经见底了。

sentences.en: June doesn't have enough money to pay for farming equipment.
sentences.zh: 琼没有足够的资金来支付农具的费用。

sentences.en: So by the time it comes to planting season, he needs even more workers.
sentences.zh: 所以到了播种季节，他需要更多的帮手。

sentences.en: I will wake up sometimes at midnight, get back home at 8, 9 o'clock and just wake up again at midnight trying to do the job of three or four different other guys.
sentences.zh: 我有时半夜醒来，晚上八九点才到家，然后半夜又得爬起来，试图一个人干三四个人的活。

sentences.en: I mean, it's not enough money and time is passing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，钱根本不够，时间却在流逝。

sentences.en: I mean, we are running out of time.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们时间不多了。

sentences.en: You know, you have a small window to plant your cane.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你只有很短的一段时间来种甘蔗。

sentences.en: And by late fall, he's starting to get desperate.
sentences.zh: 到了深秋，他开始感到绝望。

sentences.en: The date was November 8th of 2008.
And I was planting cane.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在种甘蔗。

sentences.en: And that is something, again, I can't say enough how it's that is not what should be happening in November.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，我简直无法形容，这根本不该是11月份发生的事情。

sentences.en: You should be harvesting your crop.
sentences.zh: 那时候你应该在收割庄稼。

sentences.en: You should be through planting cane at the end of September, early October, the lateSt.
sentences.zh: 最迟在九月底、十月初，你就该结束甘蔗播种了。

sentences.en: And I'm planting cane in November.
sentences.zh: 而我却在11月份种甘蔗。

sentences.en: And it was about 4 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 当时大约是四点钟。

sentences.en: My dad called and said, well, how is it going?
sentences.zh: 我爸爸打电话来问，进展得怎么样？

sentences.en: I said, well, Dad, I say, I'm trying to chop rows.
sentences.zh: 我说，爸，我在试着犁垄。

sentences.en: I'm trying to open rows.
sentences.zh: 我在试着开垄。

sentences.en: I'm trying to cover cane.
sentences.zh: 我在试着覆土种甘蔗。

sentences.en: I'm fixing breakdowns.
sentences.zh: 我在修理坏掉的机器。

sentences.en: I'm going to have to shut it down for the day because I need to try to stay and get some land prepared.
sentences.zh: 我今天打算收工了，因为我得留下来准备点土地。

sentences.en: So he said, well, you know what?
sentences.zh: 于是他说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm coming to meet you.
sentences.zh: 我这就来找你。

sentences.en: He said, we're going to stay late, me and you.
sentences.zh: 他说，我和你一起加班。

sentences.en: He said, we're going to chop land, get everything ready for the next day.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们要把地整好，为明天做好准备。

sentences.en: I'm like, Dad, no, it's close to 5 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我说，爸，别介，快五点钟了。

sentences.en: I'll try to get it.
sentences.zh: 我自己能弄完。

sentences.en: I said, just go reSt.
sentences.zh: 我说，你回去休息吧。

sentences.en: And he said, OK.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧。

sentences.en: But then 10, 15 minutes later, I watch on the road.
sentences.zh: 但过了十、十五分钟，我看着路上。

sentences.en: He came driving up.
sentences.zh: 他开车过来了。

sentences.en: I said, well, I'm here.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，我在这儿。

sentences.en: He said, let's roll up tonight, me and you.
sentences.zh: 他说，今晚咱俩一起大干一场。

sentences.en: And so that evening, his dad, even though he's retired and probably shouldn't be doing this type of work, starts to help June plant the cane.
sentences.zh: 那天傍晚，他的父亲虽然已经退休，本不该做这种劳累活，却开始帮琼种甘蔗。

sentences.en: He got on a tractor and I went hook up the covering rig and jump on another tractor.
sentences.zh: 他坐上一台拖拉机，我去把覆土机挂上，然后跳上了另一台拖拉机。

sentences.en: And I was covering cane and he was opening rows.
sentences.zh: 我在后面覆土，他在前面开垄。

sentences.en: And when he's opening the rows, you're making almost like a bed for the cane to sit in and reSt.
sentences.zh: 当他开垄时，实际上是为甘蔗铺好了一张安放和休憩的“床”。

sentences.en: And then here I come with a covering rig and I throw dirt over it and then I pack the ground.
sentences.zh: 然后我开着覆土机过来，把泥土盖在上面，再把地面压实。

sentences.en: So he's making the bed and you're tucking it in?
sentences.zh: 所以他负责铺床，你负责给它掖被子？

sentences.en: Yes, pretty much.
sentences.zh: 对，差不多是这样。

sentences.en: Yes, that's a good way to explain it.
sentences.zh: 对，这么解释很贴切。

sentences.en: Yes, yes, very much so.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常贴切。

sentences.en: And it's something he loved.
sentences.zh: 这也是他热爱的事。

sentences.en: I mean, and I love doing it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我也很热爱。

sentences.en: So to have us both in a field, your heart gets full.
sentences.zh: 所以能看到我们俩都在地里，心里满满的都是感动。

sentences.en: It's just like, you know, people don't have that opportunity to work with their family like that.
sentences.zh: 这就好像，你知道，很多人都没有机会这样和家人一起工作。

sentences.en: And then he called me up and he's like, well, June, you see, I'm almost out of diesel.
sentences.zh: 然后他打电话给我说，琼啊，你看，我的柴油快用完了。

sentences.en: And I'm like, well, Dad, you know, I'm almost out of diesel.
sentences.zh: 我说，爸，你知道，我的柴油也快用完了。

sentences.en: So what I did, I was like, Dad, you see, we're just going to have to start off in the morning.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时就说，爸，你看，我们只能明天一早再开始干了。

sentences.en: And so he left and he was going to, you know, driving back to the house.
sentences.zh: 于是他离开了，准备开车回家。

sentences.en: And I went, I detoured because I had to go pick up a few guys on another location.
sentences.zh: 而我绕了道，因为我得去另一个地方接几个人。

sentences.en: And I drove back, got on the highway and maybe three miles down the road is when I seen a bunch of taillights were going off.
sentences.zh: 等我开车返回、上了公路大约开了三英里时，我看到前方有一串刹车灯在闪烁。

sentences.en: People had flashes on and the closer I got to it, you know, I seen my dad laying down on a highway.
sentences.zh: 大家都打着双闪，等我离近一看，你知道的，我看到我爸爸躺在公路上。

sentences.en: So when I seen it, I just hurried up just through the truck and park and I got down and I went grab my dad.
sentences.zh: 所以我看到这一幕，就赶紧把卡车一停，跑下车去抓住我爸爸。

sentences.en: And there was there was a guy there and he was a doctor.
sentences.zh: 当时那里正好有一个人，他是个医生。

sentences.en: And I was like, will he be OK?
sentences.zh: 我就问，他会没事吧？

sentences.en: Will he be OK?
sentences.zh: 他会没事吧？

sentences.en: And the guy told me, no, sir, he's gone.
sentences.zh: 那个人对我说，对不起，先生，他已经走了。

sentences.en: June says another doctor told him that his dad likely died of a heart attack.
sentences.zh: 琼说另一位医生告诉他，他的父亲很可能是死于心脏病发作。

sentences.en: My dad is gone.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸走了。

sentences.en: That that's that is hard.
sentences.zh: 这，这真的太难接受了。

sentences.en: That is that is so, so hard, you know, for something he could have stayed at home, you know, but he coming to help me to try to get ahead.
sentences.zh: 这真的是，太难了，你知道的，明明他本可以在家待着的，但他却来帮我，想让我把进度赶上去。

sentences.en: And I always say this.
sentences.zh: 我总是这么说。

sentences.en: I say, you know, the only thing that that made me sane and kept me through that is is to form sugarcane because I dedicated everything to my dad from that point.
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道，唯一能让我保持理智并挺过那段日子的，就是继续种甘蔗，从那时起，我把一切都献给了我爸爸。

sentences.en: Like he loved it.
sentences.zh: 就像他热爱的那样。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我也热爱。

sentences.en: And that's what kept me going, you know, was to get back into the sugarcane and put my all into it.
sentences.zh: 这就是让我坚持下去的动力，你知道的，就是重新回到甘蔗地里，倾注我的一切。

sentences.en: So June goes back to work and he's falling even further behind.
sentences.zh: 于是琼回到工作中，却发现进度落后得更多了。

sentences.en: Oh, it was a struggle.
sentences.zh: 哦，那真是一场挣扎。

sentences.en: I mean, it's cold.
sentences.zh: 我是说，天气很冷。

sentences.en: We have a froSt.
sentences.zh: 还结了霜。

sentences.en: I'm planting cane.
sentences.zh: 我还在种甘蔗。

sentences.en: You know, I'm out in the fields and here these white farmers are riding and looking at me planting fields in December.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我在地里干活，而那些白人农场主却骑着车经过，看着我在12月份种地。

sentences.en: While all their cane is up in a beautiful stand, here I am planting in December.
sentences.zh: 当他们的甘蔗都已经长得郁郁葱葱的时候，我却还在12月播种。

sentences.en: You know, they pass, look and put a smirk on their face and just like, I mean, laughing at me, like literally laughing at me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们路过时看了一眼，脸上带着假笑，就像是在嘲笑我，真的是在嘲笑我。

sentences.en: I mean, laughing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，就是在大笑。

sentences.en: And the next year in 2009, when he went to the bank, it all started again.
sentences.zh: 第二年，也就是2009年，当他去银行时，这一切又重新上演了。

sentences.en: Poor loan amounts, late loans.
sentences.zh: 贷款额度少，放贷时间拖延。

sentences.en: A loan half as big as he expected.
sentences.zh: 贷款额度只有他期望的一半。

sentences.en: A day of that time I would wake up and be in a panic mode.
sentences.zh: 那段时间，我每天醒来都处于恐慌状态。

sentences.en: He puts up more and more collateral.
sentences.zh: 他不得不抵押越来越多的财产。

sentences.en: So his home, his parents' home, his farming equipment and his farmland.
sentences.zh: 包括他的家、他父母的家、他的农具和他的农田。

sentences.en: You see all the white drawers are in their fields spraying and starting to apply fertilizer.
sentences.zh: 你看到所有的白人农场主都在他们的地里喷洒农药、开始施肥。

sentences.en: Here I am, don't even have a crop loan yet.
sentences.zh: 而我呢，连一笔种地贷款都还没着落。

sentences.en: And then in 2010, again, 2011, again, 2012, again.
And some years, the loan would come as late as April or June.
sentences.zh: 有些年份，贷款甚至拖到4月或6月才下来。

sentences.en: I mean, I remember the county agent specifically saying, well, June, I passed down Highway 14.
sentences.zh: 我的确记得县农业推广员特意说过，嗯，琼，我路过14号公路。

sentences.en: I seen a fertilized truck and trailer.
sentences.zh: 我看到了一辆运肥卡车和拖车。

sentences.en: He said, they can't be fertilizing cane in June.
sentences.zh: 他说，他们不可能在6月份还在给甘蔗施肥。

sentences.en: He said, that's not supposed to happen.
sentences.zh: 他说，这是不应该发生的事。

sentences.en: And it was me.
sentences.zh: 而那个人其实是我。

sentences.en: It was me.
sentences.zh: 那个人就是我。

sentences.en: I mean, that is, that is crazy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这简直，简直太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Do you know how humiliating that is?
sentences.zh: 你知道那种屈辱感有多深吗？

sentences.en: As he's fertilizing late, planting late, harvesting late, he couldn't stop thinking about his cousin.
sentences.zh: 由于施肥晚、播种晚、收割也晚，他总是忍不住想起他的堂兄。

sentences.en: And we started talking.
sentences.zh: 我们开始交谈。

sentences.en: I said, Papoose, I said, I know it might not mean nothing to you now, but I said, I want to apologize.
sentences.zh: 我说，帕普斯，我说，我知道这现在对你来说可能没什么意义，但我想向你道歉。

sentences.en: Because you know what?
sentences.zh: 因为你知道吗？

sentences.en: People would always say, oh, your farm didn't last because you were lazy or your farming practices.
sentences.zh: 人们总会说，哦，你的农场做不下去是因为你懒，或者是因为你的耕作方法不对。

sentences.en: And I say, maybe we should have been there more for you because, you know, they say the same thing about me now.
sentences.zh: 而我说，也许我们当时应该更多地支持你，因为，你知道，现在他们也这样说我。

sentences.en: I'm sorry I didn't defend him more.
sentences.zh: 我很遗憾当时没有更多地为他辩护。

sentences.en: You know, and that haunts me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这一直萦绕在我的心头。

sentences.en: You know, that really haunts me because, of course, he knew what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这真的让我挥之不去，因为当然了，他很清楚自己在做什么。

sentences.en: I mean, like he told me here, he's like, June, he say, give me my loan on time.
sentences.zh: 就像他之前对我说的，琼，他说，准时把贷款发给我。

sentences.en: Give me the adequate amount of funding.
sentences.zh: 把充足的资金给我。

sentences.en: I can make a 30-ton crop just as well as anybody else.
sentences.zh: 我能像其他人一样种出亩产30吨的庄稼。

sentences.en: Or even better.
sentences.zh: 甚至比他们更好。

sentences.en: Or even better.
sentences.zh: 甚至更好。

sentences.en: I was born into this.
sentences.zh: 我生来就是干这个的。

sentences.en: And by 2014, June's yield has dropped by more than 50 percent.
sentences.zh: 到了2014年，琼的产量已经下降了50%以上。

sentences.en: 2014 was actually a horrifying year for me because...
sentences.zh: 2014年对我来说实际上是可怕的一年，因为……

sentences.en: That's when everything came to a hit.
sentences.zh: 那是所有问题集中爆发的时候。

sentences.en: Everything came to a hit in 2014.
sentences.zh: 一切都在2014年达到了顶点。

sentences.en: But we are fighters.
sentences.zh: 但我们是不服输的人。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, that's what we decided, that we were going to fight it out.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，这就是我们的决定，我们要抗争到底。

sentences.en: Next week, in the final episode of 1690, part two of June and Angie's story.
sentences.zh: 下周，在1690的最终集中，我们将播出琼和安吉故事的第二部分。

sentences.zh: 据《60分钟》报道，《杀死一只知更鸟》的演出座无虚席。

sentences.zh: 《滚石》杂志给出了五星评价，称其不容错过且难以忘怀。

sentences.zh: 向百老汇奇迹《杀死一只知更鸟》致敬。

sentences.zh: 杰西·格林称它是属于我们这个时代的一只知更鸟。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、必须全黑才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会喝到断片来睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?

sentences.zh: 他们喜欢确保你首先预订什么？
